text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I did it! I zoomed past Flower
and took
first place!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: This is real evidence that I'm new and improved!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, now that I've won, are you
finally
convinced?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Have I finally shown you that I'm both a

representative and an exemplary
Umamusume
capable of running any
race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm convinced. She's made
incredible
developments as a Sprinter
over these three
years. Now we might
just be able to...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: So, we should make my next race—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wait just a second! Isn't the Mile

Championship a...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's 400 meters longer than her
specialty... but I
know she can win it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful! I'm so glad to finally enter
one!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
1,600 meters! It's got a lovely ring to it,
just like
"class representative!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely live up to your
expectations,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's how we decide our next race
will be
the Mile Championship!
